title: Parable of the Sower
author: Octavia E. Butler
summary: In a near-future California falling apart from drought and inequality, a teenage girl with an unusual sensitivity to others' pain lives behind her community's walls. When they fail, she heads north and starts to shape a new belief.
readIf: you want a gripping, thoughtful survival story that feels uncomfortably close to real life.
skipIf: you want to avoid graphic violence and sexual assault, which appear on the road north.

pairings.reason: A starker, shorter story of surviving the ruined world after collapse, with less politics and more dread.
A more hopeful and global look at the same climate-strained near future.
